purpose: Case inputs for the #224 VLLE/LLE references (generate_vlle.jl). Inputs only: no expected values.
cubic_interactions: Explicit kij = 0.5 for every water-hydrocarbon pair and 0 for hydrocarbon pairs: an approximation chosen for implementation verification, not a qualified dataset.

nrtl.note: Synthetic partially miscible NRTL pair (tau_12 = 350 K/T, tau_21 = 520 K/T, alpha = 0.2) on the methanol and water pure-liquid and ideal-gas data. Implementation verification only; not a physical mixture.

physical_nrtl.note: Physical partially miscible pair: ChemSep/DECHEMA NRTL water/n-butanol (1 atm VLE regression, row 1921;1105) and ChemSep v8.3 1-butanol pure data via DWSIM, from data/source-extracts/liquid-chemsep-nrtl.provisional.json and components-chemsep.provisional.json; water as in the A7 extract.

experimental_lle.purpose: Model-to-experiment sanity check, reported separately from implementation agreement. Budgets were declared before the model values were compared.
experimental_lle.source: G. T. Hefter, critical evaluation of 1-butanol + water, in A. F. M. Barton (ed.), IUPAC Solubility Data Series, Vol. 15: Alcohols with Water, Pergamon, Oxford, 1984, pp. 33-35 (https://srdata.nist.gov/solubility/IUPAC/SDS-15/SDS-15.pdf)
experimental_lle.mass_percent_note: Recommended (R) best values with spread at 298 K; the organic-phase value is the simple average 20.3 of the six reported values 20.07-20.7 listed for 298 K.
experimental_lle.budget_basis: The NRTL parameters were regressed by DECHEMA from isobaric VLE data at 1 atm, not from LLE data; a predicted mutual solubility within 0.06 in mole fraction (organic phase) and within a factor of 2 (aqueous trace) is the accepted qualitative agreement.
